data.name: Progress_Count
data.comment: Processing indicator for one job. {0} is a stage name or job description, {1} the work items finished, {2} the total.

data.name: Progress_CountGrowing
data.comment: Like Progress_Count, while the job is still finding more work, so the total grows.

data.name: Progress_Working
data.comment: Processing indicator while the job works on its whole target, e.g. finding files. {0} is a stage name or job description.

data.name: Progress_Jobs
data.comment: Processing indicator for several jobs. {0} is the number of jobs, {1} the work items still to do.

data.name: Progress_TimeLeft
data.comment: {0} is the processing indicator text, {1} an estimated time such as "12 min".

data.name: Progress_Minutes
data.comment: {0} is a number of minutes.

data.name: Progress_HoursMinutes
data.comment: {0} is a number of hours, {1} of minutes.

data.name: Progress_JobLine
data.comment: Processing indicator tooltip, one line per job. {0} is the job description, {1} its progress like Progress_Count.

data.name: Progress_Failed
data.comment: {0} is a tooltip line, {1} the number of failed work items.
